summary: MGMT-009 establishes dev8 from the accepted MGMT-008 dev7 baseline, adds a performance prerequisite, defines panel-managed Management API authentication with deployment-environment precedence, and limits the first production step to one reversible 24-hour pre-canary. The shared authority changes require matching manager documentation and compatibility work before node implementation can be accepted.
compatibility: Management remains at /management/v1 with schema 1.1 and the existing capability set. NODE_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN remains the highest-priority optional source. When it is absent, a panel-generated token digest may enable the same Bearer authentication. Modern 401 and 403 responses still forbid Legacy fallback; Legacy Current, Legacy Minimal and Unknown behavior remains unchanged.
tests: Documentation-only baseline: JSON schema, workflow syntax, sensitive-literal scan and shared-document hash checks are required before merge
Manager implementation must cover Modern, Legacy Current, Legacy Minimal and Unknown compatibility
Manager collection must separate one-minute health and summary reads from ten-minute paged credential metadata synchronization
next_actions: Mirror the reviewed MGMT-009 shared authority documents into gcli2api-manager and verify their hashes match the gcli2api dev8 versions.
Update the manager roadmap and guide to recognize dev8 as the node integration branch and 0.2.0-rc.1 as the fixed candidate version.

Implement or verify the ten-minute paged credential metadata schedule, manual refresh path, environment-or-panel token compatibility, and 401/403 no-fallback behavior on a manager branch linked to MGMT-009.
Run the Modern, Legacy Current, Legacy Minimal and Unknown matrix without credential writes or active quota, test or risk operations, then link the redacted evidence to Issue 11.
